career_ladder.note: Qualifying KTET is a statutory requirement under the Right to Education (RTE) Act 2009 for appointment as school teachers in Kerala Government and Aided schools through the Kerala Public Service Commission (KPSC). Pay scales and career progression operate under the Kerala State 11th Pay Revision (G.O.(P) No. 27/2021/Fin) with time-bound higher grade (TBHG) increments at 8, 15, 22, and 27 years of service.

exam_scheme.note: Conducted by the Pareeksha Bhavan, Government of Kerala across four distinct categories adhering to NCTE norms. Each paper comprises 150 multiple choice questions carrying 150 marks for a duration of 150 minutes (2 hours 30 minutes). There is no negative marking. Qualifying threshold is 60% (90/150) for General category and 55% (82/150) for SC/ST/OBC/OEC/PH candidates. Qualified certificates carry lifetime validity.

financial_package.note: Salary computed as per Kerala State 11th Pay Revision (Scale ₹35,600–₹75,400; Entry Basic Pay ₹35,600) for Lower Primary / Upper Primary School Assistant (LPSA/UPSA) teachers appointed pursuant to KTET qualification and KPSC selection. In-hand estimate applies standardized project constant 58% DA as of 2025-07-01.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Government of Kerala Finance Department 11th State Pay Revision (G.O.(P) No. 27/2021/Fin)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on entry basic pay of ₹35,600 with mandatory 58% DA (₹20,648) plus House Rent Allowance (varying between ₹1,500 and ₹3,560 depending on Corporation, Municipality, or Grama Panchayat posting) and medical allowances, less statutory pension/NPS, State Life Insurance (SLI), and Group Insurance Scheme (GIS) deductions.
official_perks: State Government House Rent Allowance (HRA) based on local body classification
Medical insurance coverage under MEDISEP for government school teachers and dependents
Statutory pension / National Pension System (NPS) superannuation benefits
Time-Bound Higher Grade (TBHG) pay promotions at 8, 15, 22, and 27 years of service
Earned leave, maternity/paternity leave, and summer vacation privileges under Kerala Service Rules (KSR)
State Life Insurance (SLI) and Group Insurance Scheme (GIS) protection
